name: Usage Insights
description: Richer usage dashboard for Orca: daily stacked bars, a 26-week activity calendar, a weekday × hour rhythm chart, token mix, models, projects and a pixel-art skyline drawn from your Claude Code and Codex usage.

settings.title: Extra Claude Code folders
settings.description: One folder per line, read along with ~/.claude. Use a folder that holds a projects directory, or a folder of Claude Code .jsonl transcripts.

settings.title: Extra Codex folders
settings.description: One folder per line, read along with ~/.codex. Use a folder that holds a sessions directory, or a folder of Codex .jsonl transcripts.

settings.title: SSH hosts
settings.description: One host per line: a name from ~/.ssh/config, or user@host. Key or ssh-agent login only; passwords are not supported. The remote must be Linux or macOS.
